name: smwmusic-new-super-mario-bros-wii-castle
title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii - Castle
description:
The castle theme in New Super Mario Bros. Wii. If you want a good Mario-sounding castle theme that isn't from SMAS or YI, this might be just the thing. An alternative no-BNK version is also hosted in the music section.
Update: Converted to AMK format and fixed some issues in-game.
